behaviorProven: CodeSitePermit records project/plan/lease/document refs, path scope, affected zones, approval, and evidence refs.
CodeSiteDocumentReview records reviewer decision, reason codes, measured review time, baseline review time, and document lifecycle status.
CodeSiteRouteRevision proposes change-order-backed reroutes, reviews approvals, applies routes to execution plans, suspends affected clearances, and records policy decisions.
API routes expose permit, document-review, route-revision proposal, review, apply, and list flows.
Permit events are tower governance instructions, not false mutation clearance issuance.
knownRemainingWork: Permit approval is now durable governance evidence, but MutationLease gating still needs an explicit permit/change-order enforcement policy.
MCP tools need the new governance lifecycle exposed to CLI agents.
Human review time saved must be surfaced in metrics from review timing evidence.
Full release-gate proof and real multi-agent workflow proof must be regenerated at final HEAD.
